name: heldout_control_external_marker_baseline
timing: Declared before inspecting real expression values or baseline outcomes. Public repository definitions and raw obs/var metadata only informed this plan.
purpose: Transparent marker-score baseline and conditional perturbation associations; no SAE, pathway-specific mechanism, novelty, or biological-replication claim.
markers: All nine marker_sets in config/human_markers.json, without selecting favorable panels.
input: Prepared Norman h5ad with raw integer nonnegative counts in X, symbol var_names, obs perturbation, and obs gemgroup.
duplicates: Default reject any duplicate symbol. The explicitly selected --duplicate-genes sum policy sums every duplicate raw-count column by symbol before normalization, preserving exact per-cell library totals. No first/last-column selection or marker-only handling.
normalization: No HVG selection (n_hvg=0). Scanpy normalize_total target_sum=10000 and log1p on the full sparse count matrix after any declared duplicate aggregation; only then subset and densify the union of external marker columns. Reject nonraw, nonfinite, negative, and zero-library inputs.
primary_stratification: Norman gemgroup technical partitions (eight levels identified from obs metadata). Split controls and compare within gemgroup; identity permutations restricted to gemgroup. Gemgroup is not assumed to be independent biological replication. Pooled analysis, if run, is a separately labeled sensitivity.
control_split: Seed 0; sort stratum labels, randomly permute control row indices separately within each stratum; floor(n/2) discovery controls and remaining inference controls. At least 20 discovery and 20 inference controls overall. Discovery controls never enter primary or target-omission comparisons.
gene_eligibility: Using discovery controls only: nonzero log-expression in at least 10 cells and population standard deviation >1e-8. Require at least three eligible markers in a program.
score: For each eligible marker: z=(log-expression-discovery-control mean)/max(discovery-control population sd,0.1). Score is arithmetic mean across eligible markers; all weights and eligibility fixed before comparing perturbations.
perturbation_family: All single-perturbation labels other than control, without '+', having at least 20 cells. Target transcript need not be observed. Retain all nine planned panels crossed with every eligible perturbation, including unscorable comparisons with p=1.
primary_test: One-sided activation. Without strata, asymptotic tie-corrected Mann-Whitney greater. With strata, sum within-stratum U statistics and null expectations, sum standard tie-corrected U variances, normal upper-tail p with 0.5 continuity correction. AUC=sum(U_s)/sum(n_pert_s*n_control_s). Use only strata containing both groups; require at least 20 actual comparison perturbation cells and 20 unique comparison inference controls. Untestable comparisons receive p=1.
multiplicity: BH once over the complete nine-by-eligible-perturbation primary family. A primary modulator has BH q<0.05 and AUC>=0.55.
target_transcript_omission: For every program-by-perturbation comparison, remove the directly overexpressed target transcript from its marker panel if present, recompute the mean using the same discovery means/scales, and require at least three remaining markers. Re-test against inference controls. BH over the complete same-sized sensitivity family separately. Report primary and omission results together; 'survives_target_omission' is their intersection, not independent replication.
identity_omnibus: Optional default 999 permutations using program_modulation_specificity on the fixed marker scores and original heldout-control/noncontrol rows. Explicitly stipulated external marker identity is encoded with match p=0 solely to use that API; it is not a measured hypergeometric p. Holm across all nine programs; no-match/low-power programs remain p=1. Omnibus uses primary fixed marker scores, not perturbation-dependent omission scores.
limitations: Cell-level conditional associations can reflect generic response severity, viability, compositional normalization, guide effects, or unobserved confounding. Heldout controls prevent reuse for score fitting and testing but do not provide an independent perturbation-validation dataset. Marker-score positives do not establish SAE superiority, mechanism, novelty, or discovery.
no_outcome_tuning: Do not change panels, thresholds, split seed, direction, strata policy, or primary family after examining outcomes. Any later changes require a new labeled plan and sensitivity analysis.
